# Carzo

Carzo is a European used-car search and marketplace bridge. It helps users search across marketplaces such as Kleinanzeigen, AutoScout24, OLX, Otomoto, Mobile.de and other local platforms, then use filters, Telegram alerts and AI-assisted listing analysis to evaluate vehicles faster.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://carzo.site/
- Public catalog: https://carzo.site/app/feed
- About: https://carzo.site/about
- Support: https://carzo.site/support
- Privacy: https://carzo.site/privacy
- Terms: https://carzo.site/terms
- Cookies: https://carzo.site/cookies
- Guides: https://carzo.site/blog
- Automotive magazine / digest: https://carzo.site/magazine
- Pricing data: https://carzo.site/pricing.md

## What Carzo does

- Public search and sorting of used-car listings without requiring login.
- Natural-language AI search that turns buyer phrases into filters.
- AI-assisted vehicle analysis that highlights risks, strengths, common model issues and seller-description signals.
- Telegram alerts for new cars matching saved search profiles.
- Planned marketplace-account bridge for messaging, saved listings, auto-replies and cross-posting from user-owned platform accounts.
